source.title: Astronomy and Mathematical Astrology
source.author: Deepak Kapoor
source.note: Institute of Astrology, Bharatiya Vidya Bhawan. Every value below is printed in the book as a worked example; page numbers are the book's own, not the PDF's.
source.numbering: Nakshatra and tithi numbers and names come from the book's own tables (nakshatra table pp.83-85, tithi table p.172), not only from the sentence quoted on each example.

ayanamsa.quote: By adding the yearly rate of precession of 50".29 per year to the corrected value of 23 degrees 15 minutes as on 21st March 1956, we get the present ayanamsha of 24 degrees 00 minutes 56 seconds as on 1st January 2011.
ayanamsa.why_not_exact: The book extrapolates in a straight line from the 1956 committee value; Swiss Ephemeris uses the refined Lahiri series. The two differ by ~17", far below a pada. The tolerance is one arcminute, which is still tight enough that switching to Raman (~1.2 deg away), Fagan-Bradley (~50') or KP (~6') would fail.

nakshatra.quote: Hence Moon is in 18th nakshatra which is Jyeshtha in the 4th pada or part.
Consider Moon at 3°23°42' at birth in the Cancer sign... janma nakshatra is Ashlesha 3rd pada.
Moon in nakshatra - Purva Phalguni. (The extent of P.Phalguni nakshatra is 4-13-20 to 4-26-40)
nakshatra.expect_note: The book prints the nakshatra and its lord here, not the pada. Nothing in this file is asserted that the page does not state.

tithi.quote: This means that 4 tithis have passed and the 5th tithi is running.

karana.quote: 8 Karana have passed and the 9th Karana is running, or the first karna of 5th tithi is running.
karana.numbering: Position 1 of the 60-karana cycle is the fixed Kintughna; positions 2-57 are the seven movable karanas repeating eight times; 58-60 are Shakuni, Chatushpad, Naga. Position 9 is therefore the first movable, Bava.

yoga.quote: Thus 23 yogas have elapsed and 24th yoga called Shukla is running.

balance.quote: Dasha balance at birth = 13.7 years. Converting into years, months and days we get, Balance of Venus dasha as 13 years, 8 months, 12 days.

succession.quote: Add date of birth of native 54-1-15; Venus upto 67-9-27; Sun upto 73-9-27; Moon upto 83-9-27; Mars upto 90-9-27... the present running dasha is of Rahu which has started on 27-9-1990 and will continue upto 27-9-2008.
succession.why_this_matters: The book converts the fractional year to months and days at 30 days to the month, then adds the whole y-m-d to the birth date as calendar units. This engine multiplies by a fixed 365.25-day year. The two land on the same day, which is the point of pinning it: a change to DAYS_PER_YEAR would move these dates off the printed ones.

subperiods.quote: Moon/Rahu/Venus = 10 x 18 x 20 / 40 = 90 days or 3 months

vimshottari.subperiod_note: The book's shortcuts (antar in months = AxB/10, pratyantar in days = AxBxC/40) assume 30-day months, so a printed duration can sit a day either side of a real calendar span containing a leap day. One day of tolerance; anything larger is a bug, not a convention.

sankalpa.quote: The period when the Sun is transiting the signs of Capricorn to Gemini is known as the period of uttarayana Sun. The period in which the Sun is transiting the signs of Cancer to Sagittarius is known as dakshinayana Sun. ... Cancer and Leo: Varsha or rainy season. [p.79] Vikrami (Solar) +57 years, Shaka -78 years, both beginning at solar ingress in nirayana Aries.
sankalpa.cross_checked_against: A kundali hand-cast in Parbat, Nepal for 17 Aug 2004 07:40, which states दक्षिण अयने, वर्षा ऋतौ, भाद्र मासे, सम्वत् २०६१, शक १९२६.

tribhagi.source: The त्रिभागी महादशा table printed on the same hand-cast kundali.
tribhagi.note: Vimshottari with a third removed. Every period below is read from the printed table; they cumulate to 80, which is 120 x 2/3 and is what the table's last cell states.

yogini.source: The योगिनी महादशा table printed on the same hand-cast kundali.
yogini.quote: Header भ उ सि सं म पि धा भ्रा over 5 6 7 8 1 2 3 4, cumulating 5 11 18 26 27 29 32 36.
yogini.note: Magha is the tenth nakshatra and (10 + 3) mod 8 = 5, so she begins in the fifth yogini, Bhadrika — which is what the printed table starts with.

hand_cast_kundali_1975.source: Kundali hand-cast by Dharmadatta Timilsina, Deupur-9, Parbat, for a birth at Deupur-7 Lukepani, Parbat, Nepal.
hand_cast_kundali_1975.why_this_one: 23 November 1975 in Nepal is the case rule 5 exists for: Kathmandu ran +5:30 until 1986, not +5:45. Computing it at +5:45 puts the birth 15 minutes out, which is about 3.75 degrees of ascendant.
hand_cast_kundali_1975.planet_note: Read off the जन्म लग्न कुण्डली lotus, whose cells are numbered by rashi: 1 Ketu, 3 Mars, 4 Moon+Saturn, 6 Venus, 7 Rahu, 8 Sun+Mercury, 12 Jupiter, the rest empty. All twelve cells agree.

known_divergence.nakshatra: The guru has Pushya pada 1; we have Punarvasu pada 4. Our Moon is 14 arcmin short of the boundary, and his own figures say his Moon had been in Pushya for 18 palas — 7 minutes. The two Moons are about half a degree apart, which is ordinary between a traditional siddhanta and a modern ephemeris, but here it lands on a boundary and changes the dasha lord from Jupiter to Saturn.
known_divergence.karana: He has Gara, we have Taitila. Gara belongs to tithi 21 and he names tithi 20, so his own two values do not sit together; ours do.

samvatsara.source: Fitted to the two hand-cast kundalis, twenty-nine years apart.
samvatsara.caveat: Two documents in one tradition, not a rule from a text. The southern Ugadi reckoning names a different year for the same date.
